facts.text: Audrey recently purchased new beds for the animals to provide them with extra comfort as the weather cooled down.

evidence.quote: Last week I even got some new beds for them, just to give them some extra comfort now the weather's cooling down and they were happy!

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of the animals on the new beds, showing them as cozy and comfortable.

evidence.quote: Sure! Here's a pic of them. Super cozy and comfy. My furry friends love them!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the animals enjoy snoozing on the new beds, curling up and snuggling like they are in a cloud.

evidence.quote: They absolutely love it! They curl up and snuggle like they're in a cloud - it's adorable!
